An outstanding Israeli urological surgeon and specialist in cancer surgery, with more than 30 years of clinical and research experience.

Professional experience

  • Specialisation in the surgical treatment of tumours of the kidney and urinary tract.
  • Medical degree from the faculty of medicine, Hebrew University of Jerusalem.
  • Fellowship in urology at the Sheba medical centre.

Research achievements

  • Specialisation in surgical uro-oncology in the United States.
  • Research into the molecular biology of malignant tumours at Columbia University, New York.

Education and clinical experience

  • Medical degree.
  • Head of the uro-oncology service at the Chaim Sheba hospital.
  • Head of the urology department at the Meir medical centre since 2002.

Professional memberships

  • Lecturer in the department of urology, faculty of medicine, Tel Aviv University.
  • Member of the urological societies of Israel, Europe and the United States.
  • Editor of the journal Urology Update.

Areas of work

  • Use of advanced methods of minimally invasive endoscopic surgery.
  • Particular attention to organ-preserving operations.
  • Expertise in prostate surgery, bladder cancer, kidney tumours and testicular cancer.

Ilya Pekarsky: leading orthopaedic surgeon and specialist in spinal treatment

Professional overview:
Professor Ilya Pekarsky is a world leader in orthopaedics and spinal surgery, specialising in scoliosis, degenerative disc disease, the surgical and non-surgical treatment of herniated discs, minimally invasive spinal operations and endoscopic surgery. For his outstanding achievements in spinal treatment, Professor Pekarsky was recognised continuously as the best spinal surgeon in Israel from 2008 to 2012 by the Israel Medical Association.

Specialisation:

  • Scoliosis
  • Degenerative disc disease
  • Surgical and non-surgical treatment of herniated discs
  • Minimally invasive spinal operations
  • Endoscopic spinal operations
  • Disc replacement
  • Removal of spinal tumours
  • Treatment of spinal fractures
  • Operations on the cervical spine

Education:

  • Medical faculty of the Second Moscow Medical Institute, Russia.
  • Residency in orthopaedics and spinal surgery, Tel Aviv University, Israel.
  • Fellowships and advanced training at medical centres in the United States, France, Switzerland, Austria, the Netherlands, Italy and Spain.

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Orthopaedic Association (IOA).
  • Israel Spine Surgery Association.
  • European Spine Society.
  • European board for the certification of spinal surgeons.

Dr Pekarsky is a leading expert in orthopaedics and spinal surgery whose innovative treatment methods have allowed thousands of patients to return to an active life. His distinctive approach to treatment and his wide range of surgical skills produce highly effective results and have earned international recognition.

Dr Irina Stefanski is an outstanding oncologist with almost 30 years of experience in treating solid tumours. Her deep knowledge and experience in oncology have allowed thousands of patients to return to a healthy life, not only by dealing with the underlying disease but also by minimising the side effects of treatment, such as toxicity, fatigue and nausea.

One of the key aspects of her professional work is dealing with the recurrence of various cancers, including cancer of the breast, the vagina, the cervix and the digestive tract. Dr Stefanski attaches great importance not only to treatment but also to following patients up, so that any return of the disease can be detected and prevented in good time.

In her clinical practice she makes active use of a comprehensive approach to cancer treatment, applying the most modern and effective protocols. Her commitment to continuous professional development and to her patients' wellbeing makes Dr Stefanski one of the leaders in oncology.

EDUCATION

  • Faculty of medicine, Grodno Medical Institute, Belarus
  • Internship at the medical centre in Mazyr, Belarus
  • Fellowship in general and internal medicine at the Ichilov medical centre, Tel Aviv, Israel
  • Specialisation in clinical oncology at the Israeli national cancer centre
  • Specialisation in oncology at the MD Anderson Cancer Center, Houston, USA
  • Fellowship in oncology at a clinic in Germany

LANGUAGES

  • Hebrew
  • English
  • Russian
  • German

MEMBERSHIP OF INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATIONS

  • Israel Medical Association
  • Israel Society of Clinical Oncology and Radiation Therapy (ISCORT)
  • European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO)
  • American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO)

Dr Irina Zhivelyuk is a recognised specialist in oncology and chemotherapy. She currently holds a senior post, heading the chemotherapy day unit and the breast cancer department at the Assuta clinic. Her high level of skill and professionalism were acknowledged when she was invited to serve as a consultant to the Israel Cancer Association.

Dr Zhivelyuk not only treats patients actively but is also deeply involved in research on breast cancer. Her work is not limited to treatment: she is actively engaged in reducing pain in patients with cancer. Palliative care and the effort to improve the quality of life of people facing malignant disease are also an important part of her professional path.

Dr Zhivelyuk constantly seeks new approaches and treatment methods in order to give her patients the best possible chance against the disease. Her dedication to her profession and her wish to help make her one of the leaders in oncology.

EDUCATION

  • Faculty of medicine, Crimean university, Sevastopol
  • Specialisation in the oncology department of the Second Medical University, Moscow
  • Fellowship at the Beilinson centre, Israel
  • Specialisation in oncology and radiotherapy at the Ichilov centre

LANGUAGES

  • Hebrew
  • English

MEMBERSHIP OF INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATIONS

  • Israel Medical Association
  • Israel Cancer Association, consultant
  • American Society of Clinical Oncology
  • Israel Society of Clinical Oncology and Radiology

Specialisation: radiology

Main areas of specialisation:

Dr Yoav Lipsky is a leading specialist in radiology at the Assuta clinic. He has many years of experience and specialises in the treatment and diagnosis of various cancers.

  • Treatment of tumours of the digestive tract
  • Precisely targeted radiation therapy
  • Radiology
  • Treatment and prevention of metastases
  • Diagnosis of primary tumours in various locations
  • Pulmonary oncology
  • Treatment of inoperable growths

Summary:

Dr Yoav Lipsky is an outstanding neuroradiologist and a leading specialist at the Assuta clinic. He has considerable experience in the treatment and diagnosis of various cancers and is actively engaged in research, having published more than 30 papers on radiology and oncology.

Education and clinical experience:

  • Faculty of medicine: Technion, Israel
  • Fellowship: Ichilov medical centre, Israel
  • Internship in oncology: Rabin Medical Centre, Israel
  • Fellowship in radiology: USA

Academic and research work:

Dr Lipsky is actively engaged in research and has more than 30 publications on radiology and oncology. His research and development work contributes to the advance of radiology and to improving methods of cancer treatment.

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Society of Clinical Oncology and Radiation Therapy

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Dr Yoav Lipsky is known for his advanced methods of treatment and diagnosis, thanks to which many patients have received medical care of the highest quality and improved their quality of life.

Dr Konstantin Galperin is an outstanding specialist of the highest category in foot and ankle surgery, working at the Assuta hospital. His name is associated with significant successes in treating complex cases of orthopaedic disease and injury of the foot and ankle. His professional experience and knowledge allow him to perform complex surgical interventions with great precision and effectiveness.

Education and professional development

  • Dr Galperin took his medical degree in the faculty of medicine at Tel Aviv University.
  • He then completed a fellowship in the treatment of the ankle joint and foot at the Rabin Medical Centre.
  • His training also included international advanced courses in Germany, Turkey, France, Iceland and the Netherlands, which has allowed him to remain at the forefront of modern orthopaedic surgery.

Languages

  • Hebrew
  • English
  • Russian

Experience

  • Dr Galperin has more than 17 years of clinical experience, which makes him one of the most experienced specialists in his field.

Clinical and research experience

  • He takes an active part in developing new treatment methods and surgical techniques, as his participation in international congresses and his authorship of research papers confirm.
  • His research and publications contribute to the development of orthopaedics internationally.

Membership of professional associations

  • Dr Galperin is a member of the Israel Orthopaedic Association and the Israel Foot and Ankle Surgery Society, which reflects his active involvement in the professional community.

In his work Dr Galperin combines deep theoretical knowledge with advanced practical skill, which has earned him high respect among colleagues and patients alike.
